title: Hunts FH-037S: Call the projection from the Stripe webhook, checkout return and repair cron

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail:
Behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED and best-effort (a failure never fails settlement), call projectTicketBenefits after recordTicketFromSession and from the checkout return, feed refund, partial refund and dispute events through decideReversal and applyReversal with the canonical refund or dispute id as the reference, attach the verified attendee when a guest seat is claimed (attachAttendee), and run repairMissingBenefits and reconcileTicket from a cron. Done when: a signed test event matrix creates one benefit per seat, a replay changes nothing, and a swallowed failure is noticed by a gate. Requires: FH-037, FH-039, FH-040. Owner role: Billing and database.

Built 2026-11-11: lib/hunts/commerce-hooks.ts (reversalForCharge, reversalForDispute, guarded, nextIntentState) and commerce-webhook.ts (huntsAfterTicketSession, huntsAfterChargeRefund, huntsAfterDisputeClosed, attachClaimedSeats, huntsRepairPass). The Stripe webhook calls them after recordTicketFromSession, on charge.refunded and on charge.dispute.closed; the on-page checkout return calls the projection; the reconcile-transfers cron runs the repair pass. All best effort and dark until HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED. A swallowed failure leaves a pending hunt_commerce_intents row with its error (retried with backoff, 12 tries, then review) or a stable [hunts-commerce] log line. A partial refund opens a review case, never a guessed seat. Guest seat claims attach from a repair scan of pending_claim seats, not from the sign-in path.
